name: MAXX
source:
Maxx is a  very manly robot who believes in the POWER OF FRIENDSHIP. He absolutely LOVES his shiny round metal body, and hates it when it has to go under maintenance. During that time, he is stuck within a female body, but even then he still considers himself to be a manly man.

[From [url=http://calamitousintents.wordpress.com/2010/12/11/flyable-heart-review/]Calamitous Intent's review[/url]]
